name: Women’s Instinct for Developing and Ushering in Scientific Heights & Innovation
benefit:
> **Category A:**

  - **Fellowship (Principal Investigator):** ₹75,000/- per month  - **Research Assistant:** 1 position provided  - **Research Grant:** ₹5,00,000 per year  - **Institutional Overhead Charges:** ₹1,00,000/- per annum
> **Category B:**

  - **Fellowship (Principal Investigator):** ₹85,000/- per month  - **Research Assistant:** 1 position provided  - **Research Grant:** ₹5,00,
_eligibility_text: > **Category A: The following are the primary eligibility criteria-** 1. **Employment:** Women Scientists who are permanent employees but retiring in a year or already retired/superannuated from government academic/research institutions. 1. **Age:** 57-62 years 1. **Qualification:** Women Scientists having Ph.D. in Basic/Applied Sciences or equivalent degree. 1. **Research Experience:** Minimum 2 R&D projects as Principal Investigator with excellent track record. 1. **Publications:** Minimum 20 research publications with impact factor. > **Category B: The following are the primary eligibility criteria-** 1. **Employment:** Women who are not permanent employees in any institution but working temporarily and have completed 2 independent research projects as Principal Investigator. 1. **Age:** 45-62 years 1. **Qualification:** Women Scientists having Ph.D. in Basic/Applied Sciences or equivalent degree. 1. **Research Experience:** Minimum 2 R&D projects as Principal Investigator with excellent track record. 1. **Publications:** Minimum 10 research publications with impact factor. > **Proposals are invited from senior women scientists in the following scientific disciplines:** 1. Physical &amp; Mathematical Sciences 1. Chemical Sciences 1. Life Sciences 1. Earth &amp; Atmospheric Sciences 1. Engineering &amp; Technology 1. S&amp;T-based Societal Research > **Co-Investigator (Co-I):** 'WIDUSHI' fellow should choose a permanent faculty as Co-I (male/female) of the project for academic and administrative support in project implementation. The service of Co-I has to be due for a period not less than the proposed period of the WIDUSHI project. The Co-I is not eligible for any separate grants under the programme.
